llm.summary: FAF outperformed SPY and reached CLEAN_LIFTOFF under a mixed recorded cause, so both company-specific and contextual mechanisms remain plausible. No supplied evidence separates those components.
llm.root_cause: FAF outperformed SPY and reached CLEAN_LIFTOFF under a mixed recorded cause, so both company-specific and contextual mechanisms remain plausible. No supplied evidence separates those components.
llm.lesson: The selection stack surfaced the winner, but the company-alpha and rotation books did not leave enough attribution evidence to divide credit.
llm.engines_credit: The combined selection process is the role model; company-alpha, Financials rotation, catalyst, and macro organs remain attribution laggards because their contemporaneous traces are absent.

causal_chain.mechanism: A company-specific component is one part of the recorded mixed explanation.
causal_chain.counterfactual: Without company-specific strength, contextual tailwinds alone may not have produced the same relative outcome.

causal_chain.mechanism: Financials strength may have amplified the company component.
causal_chain.counterfactual: If Financials were weak over the holding path, company alpha would need to explain more of the result.

causal_chain.mechanism: Buy-lane placement with no recorded process fault may have captured the move efficiently.
causal_chain.counterfactual: Delayed placement might have reduced participation, although the path is not supplied.

alternate_explanations: A post-entry external event produced the liftoff

signal_hypotheses.feature: Confluence between residual company strength and sector rotation
signal_hypotheses.measurement: Interact entry-date residual momentum with contemporaneous Financials relative breadth.
signal_hypotheses.expected_direction: Positive confluence should associate with clean liftoff more strongly than either component alone.
signal_hypotheses.falsifier: The interaction adds no stable explanatory value out of sample.
